host_model: shared Linux GNU x86_64 host; unrelated work retained
sanitization: Allowlisted numeric observations, status, tool identities, output hashes and selected metadata. All 240 command records and 117 timed/excluded observations are retained. Absolute paths, argv, environment, raw output and source inventories remain private. Hashes bind the original reports, not a public execution-input closure. Parsed numeric values are preserved; JSON lexical forms may change.
ratio_direction: Explicit numerator/denominator labels govern interpretation. Legacy stats baseline_median and baseline_p95 describe the first tuple/numerator, not a fixed stock lane.
scope: Metadata-only dependency-primed root checks on three fixed package targets.
Matched primary treatment is the joint compiler CGU16/ThinLTO/preparation/native build package; separate knob effects are unidentified.
Stock1.99.1 differs in compiler/Cargo/LLVM versions and is a secondary reference.
No frontend override; four Cargo jobs and fixed affinity for all lanes.
Bootstrap intervals assume independent pairs; sign tests assume exchangeability under the null. Shared-host cache, thermal and carryover effects remain.
Collector and observer overhead retained; no subtraction.
CPU covers waited ancestry. RSS is largest waited process, not simultaneous aggregate memory.
Historical control capture preservation failed; its input binding was accepted retrospectively with explicit limits.
One preserved diagnostic payload duration differs by one f64 ULP between usage JSON and embedded report; integer/status/hash fields exact. Not outer wall_seconds used in analysis.
Seven monitor size probes retried only disappearing-file races; first errors and succeeding probes retained privately. No workload retry.
V1 label and V2 sandbox failures had zero workload records; V3 inputs and corrected namespace probes frozen before data.
